findings.claim: A calibrated two-ratio closure improves local electron-temperature reconstruction within the retained two-hour interval.
findings.scope: One2-hour MMS1 interval. All ion moments have qualityflag66 (saturation plus highMach); ion targets excluded before any fit. Electron flags0 and FGMflags0 retained. Eulerian spacecraft samples are not tracked fluid parcels. Two held blocks and one orbit segment do not establish a universal plasma law.
